# Anne Shirley & Davy Keith

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — affectionate guardian and friend · since v2  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P37](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0037), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P34](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0034), +1 more</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Commands — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — has the authority to discipline and guide him · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, getting into trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church and pumping water over [Dora](../character/dora.md) after coaxing her into a pigpen. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to gently guide [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) while removing a toad he hid in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed after complaining about [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly sneaks into Marilla's room and carries the toad out to the cherry orchard on a fire shovel before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P61](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0061), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After the painter finishes, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers that the hall has been painted a glaring blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. The news spreads, devastating the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but the villagers rally behind the young people while blaming the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from school enjoying the autumn day until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses he trapped her there and lied about it, but breaks down when he realizes lying is wrong, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish and educate him.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confronts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about his dishonesty and his decision to test Marilla's warning by skipping his prayers. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the story with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) downstairs, and the two discuss Davy's mischief compared to Dora's good behavior, agreeing that they both feel a special affection for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) despite his faults.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P75](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0075), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P81](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0081), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088)_

> In a miserable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to explode in the stove and losing her temper enough to whip [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. That evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). To Anne's surprise, the punishment earns Anthony's respect, as later confirmed when he behaves pleasantly and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) shares his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P40](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0040), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter announcing that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She excitedly prepares a special menu, cleans the house meticulously, and enlists the help of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for the event.
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P24](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0024), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P28](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0028)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) eagerly decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and other guests. A series of mishaps ensues: [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins the lemon pies, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the peas are ruined by too much sugar, and Miss Barry's expensive platter gets broken. A letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later explains that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) disappointed but resilient.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed after answering his curious questions about sleep and jam. Later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and tells her where they might find a willow-ware platter to replace Aunt Josephine's. The next day, the two girls drive to the Copp farm on [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally falls through the roof of a duck house while trying to look in the pantry window, leaving her stuck until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and releases her.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) while his grandmother is away, having tea with him and listening to his imaginative thoughts. Later at home, she puts a jealous [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and reassures him of her affection. Afterwards, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and reflects on how mature he has become.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bedtime-talks with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about trying to be good, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to discuss their village improvement society's progress and upcoming plans. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and chats with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P61](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0061)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md) while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes off with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to do chores. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is changing a feather bed, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). Despite accidentally dyeing her nose red with rug dye beforehand, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) manages to clean herself up, borrow food from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and entertain her guests with a pleasant dinner and a walk through the woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P20](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0020), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> At school, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) gets into a dispute over a picture drawn on a slate, while [Dora](../character/dora.md) becomes frightened of staying in the dark after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) shares stories of her family's ghosts. Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods on their way to a tea party and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There they meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), who invite them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) repeatedly scolds [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for his poor table manners. Later, news arrives that the twins' uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), has passed away and left money for their care, securing their future at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>

> Uncle Abe's weather prediction unexpectedly comes true when a destructive hail and lightning storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and buildings. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins weather the fury of the tempest at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before assessing the community-wide destruction, which includes the loss of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P33](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0033), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when a well-dressed woman arrives in a wagon looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). The visitor reveals she is Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), and leaves to go to his house. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the surprise, and later [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) add further details about Emily's return.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the background of his marital separation and how his late parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) led to their split before [Emily](../character/emily.md) returned. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her own regrets about being too hasty, while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discusses the Harrisons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her impending departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in the orchard before walking to the Post Office. On her way home, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her on the bridge and tries to express his deeper feelings, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cuts the moment short. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts and talks with young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) about her plans and growing up.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after saying emotional goodbyes to her family and friends. She travels by boat and train alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie, eventually arriving in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) where [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) greets her and takes her to their new boarding house.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010)_

> After completing their first-term examinations at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) heads to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is joyfully welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and the twins, later helping little [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) resolve his guilt over wanting to say a bad word. Over [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from Miss Lavendar, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> Rebellious against Mrs. Lynde's rules, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerces [Dora](../character/dora.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and playing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). Afterwards, he lies to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to cover up his behavior, but he is tormented by guilt until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home that night and listens to his confession.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v3 ch.Transgressors P56](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0056), [v3 ch.Transgressors P93](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0093)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a quiet evening with [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully admits her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her as best she can, and the conversation deeply affects her view of life. Shortly after, Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the community to mourn her at her funeral.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays, which are dampened by severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and worries about her college finances. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) engages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in amusing chatter until Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail. Among the letters, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that Miss Josephine Barry has died and left her a thousand dollars in her will.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

_Sources: [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P21](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0021), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is reminiscing at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unexpectedly arrives home a day early from college. They embrace and chat about her walk home, after which [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) arrives and eagerly tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his lost tooth, his adventures, and his future marriage plans.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gables P4](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0004), [v3 ch.Gables P5](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0005), [v3 ch.Gables P11](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0011), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while helping comfort [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about his weekend schoolwork. They discuss local village funerals, gossip, and Diana's upcoming wedding. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting mournfully on changing friendships and growing up.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening
